description:
Liquidity snapshot for a token's primary trading pair: price, 24h volume, pair count and the chains it trades on. Optional trade_activity reports buys plus sells in the last hour and the preceding five hours from that selected pool's raw integer counts. Missing counts are omitted; observed zeros remain zero.
Set include_known_address_balances to true to read the selected pool and canonical zero/dead addresses at one verified block on Ethereum, BSC or Base. Percentages use the token's totalSupply at that block. Partial results identify missing reads. These are token balances, without attribution to an owner, lock or burn.
chain_hint is a network preference. If only other networks appear in the initial listing, VetAgent checks the requested network before returning another market. When present, network_selection explains the requested lookup and returned scope. A market from another network is reported separately from any requested-network change.
For native change estimates, pass the previous comparison_context unchanged (or [] to start). The server selects the latest comparable client observation with the same token, chain, complete pool or market ID and provider, and separately discloses a change from the most recent selected pool. It never subtracts different pools or providers, and refuses stale fallback. Context is bounded client observation, not signed service history. No server history is stored. Legacy calls remain snapshots. The local examples/liquidity_compare.py CLI remains available for saved replies. Qualified Ethereum Curve and Balancer markets may use best_pair_market_id in place of best_pair_address. Carry the entire DexScreener ID for rechecks and never use its components to address a contract or run a simulation. Keep best_pair_dex in Balancer observations. They may identify a market with no USD estimate, without replacing an earlier numeric baseline. checked_at is reply time. market_retrieved_at is when VetAgent obtained the selected estimate and may precede the reply for cached data. If no newer market retrieval is confirmed, the comparison returns no_new_market_data and keeps the baseline.
Check 'status' before using the numbers. 'ok' means usable upstream data, not independently verified reserves or executable sell depth. The optional liquidity_reserve_check marker says 'not_checkable' when a positive selected estimate has no computable reserve cap. A missing marker never asserts that reserves, prices or an exit trade were independently verified. 'unavailable' means the upstream request failed, which does NOT mean the token has no liquidity. 'not_found' means no trading pair exists for this address at all. 'unpriced' means pairs exist but no source has costed them, so liquidity_usd is null and the depth is unknown -- this is NOT a report of zero liquidity. 'drained' means the USD liquidity estimates for the returned market scope are zero, including estimates capped by reserve evidence. A drained result with a complete pool ID, chain and provider can participate in a same-pool recheck. This identity is included only for a single pool whose provider reported zero.

chain_hint.description: Optional network preference; inspect network_selection if returned.

comparison_context.description: Optional client-carried observations, at most 8 and 8192 UTF-8 JSON bytes. Pass a prior comparison_context unchanged, or [] to start. These are client observations, not signed service records. An identified drained observation has a numeric USD estimate of zero. An unpriced Balancer observation can identify a market and has a null USD estimate. No server history is stored.

best_pair_market_id.description: Full DexScreener Ethereum Curve or Balancer market ID. For market rechecks only.

include_known_address_balances.description: Opt in to a fixed-block public node read.

name: get_token_liquidity

best_pair_address.description: Optional complete validated selected-pool ID on ok results: 20-byte/32-byte EVM hex or 32-byte Solana base58, preserving case. Also included on an identified single-pool drained result. Omitted for invalid or conflicting identity. Old truncated display IDs cannot establish exact cross-response identity. No sell simulation runs.

best_pair_market_id.description: Full DexScreener Ethereum Curve or Balancer market ID. For market rechecks only.

checked_at.description: Reply time in ISO-8601 UTC, not the source observation time. Source data may be cached.

comparison.description: Returned when comparison_context is supplied. Uses the latest strictly earlier comparable client observation of this token, chain, complete pool or market ID and provider, including the venue for a market ID. USD estimate change is not a reserve flow or executable depth. A repeat or unordered market retrieval preserves the prior baseline (no_new_market_data). A changed pool_transition and baseline_is_latest_observation=false disclose a return to an older pool baseline.

after_checked_at.description: When this answer was made, ISO-8601 UTC.

before_checked_at.description: When this answer was made, ISO-8601 UTC.

nonprior_observations.description: Client observations at or after the current reply time; excluded as baselines.

previous_checked_at.description: When this answer was made, ISO-8601 UTC.

previous_market_id.description: Full DexScreener Ethereum Curve or Balancer market ID. For market rechecks only.

comparison_context.description: Optional client-carried observations, at most 8 and 8192 UTF-8 JSON bytes. Pass a prior comparison_context unchanged, or [] to start. These are client observations, not signed service records. An identified drained observation has a numeric USD estimate of zero. An unpriced Balancer observation can identify a market and has a null USD estimate. No server history is stored.

best_pair_market_id.description: Full DexScreener Ethereum Curve or Balancer market ID. For market rechecks only.

supply_percent.description: Percent of total supply. Six decimals, or '<0.000001' for a smaller positive share.
Percent of total supply. Six decimals, or '<0.000001' for a smaller positive share.
Percent of total supply. Six decimals, or '<0.000001' for a smaller positive share.

message.description: Manual recheck guidance when rpc_rate_limited reports an HTTP 429 on the node's chain ID read.

reason.description: Why the fixed-block observation is unavailable.

liquidity_reserve_check.description: The positive upstream estimate was retained, but its reserve amounts could not be checked. Absence of this marker makes no verification claim.

market_retrieved_at.description: When VetAgent obtained the selected market estimate, including cache hits. This is not exchange trade time. Null means the retrieval time could not be verified.

network_selection.description: Requested network, observed market scope and outcome of the extra DexScreener lookup. An empty listing differs from an unconfirmed lookup.

served_stale.description: Present only when an upstream was unreachable and this answer used cached data. Each entry names the source and how many seconds old it was.

source.description: Liquidity data provider, not the trading venue.

trade_activity.description: Buys plus sells for this pool in the last hour and the five hours before it, as of the listing observation. Omitted when the provider's counts are missing or inconsistent.

title: Get Token Liquidity
